text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Politicians whose parties went unregistered by the electoral commission may be barred from holding official positions in any political party during the military government's transition to democracy.
- Head of state General Sani Abacha says decrees affecting the banking industry are being reviewed to stem further distress in the sector.
- Conglomerate UAC is to hold talks with Scandinavian investors over the next two weeks. It is thought to be trying to attract partnership for its printing and packaging business.
- Sources reveal that Nigeria is far from any concessionary debt reduction.
